030@MessageProps(
031    opCode=-54,
032    size=6,
033    type=MessageType.REQUEST,
034    characteristic=Characteristic.CONTROL,
035    signed=true,
036    response=ChangeControlIQSettingsResponse.class
037)
038public class ChangeControlIQSettingsRequest extends Message {
039
040    private boolean enabled;
041    private int weightLbs;
042    private int totalDailyInsulinUnits;
043    private int changeBitmaskRaw;
044    private Set<ChangeBitmask> changeBitmask;
045
046    public ChangeControlIQSettingsRequest() {
047        this.cargo = EMPTY;
048    }
049
050    public ChangeControlIQSettingsRequest(byte[] raw) {
051        parse(raw);
052    }
053
054    public ChangeControlIQSettingsRequest(boolean enabled, int weightLbs, int totalDailyInsulinUnits) {
055        this(enabled, weightLbs, totalDailyInsulinUnits, ChangeBitmask.ENABLED.id());
056    }
057
058    public ChangeControlIQSettingsRequest(boolean enabled, int weightLbs, int totalDailyInsulinUnits, Set<ChangeBitmask> changeBitmask) {
059        this(enabled, weightLbs, totalDailyInsulinUnits, ChangeBitmask.toBitmask(changeBitmask));
060    }
061
062    public ChangeControlIQSettingsRequest(boolean enabled, int weightLbs, int totalDailyInsulinUnits, int changeBitmaskRaw) {
063        parse(buildCargo(enabled, weightLbs, totalDailyInsulinUnits, changeBitmaskRaw));
064    }
065
066    /**
067     * <table border="1">
068     * <caption>Parsed fields for ChangeControlIQSettingsRequest:</caption>
069     * <tr><td><code>enabled</code></td><td><code>raw[0] == 1</code></td></tr>
070     * <tr><td><code>weightLbs</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 1)</code></td></tr>
071     * <tr><td><code>totalDailyInsulinUnits</code></td><td><code>raw[4]</code></td></tr>
072     * <tr><td><code>changeBitmaskRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[5]</code></td></tr>
073     * <tr><td><code>changeBitmask</code></td><td><code>ChangeBitmask.fromBitmask(changeBitmaskRaw)</code></td></tr>
074     * </table>
075     */
076    public void parse(byte[] raw) { 
077        raw = this.removeSignedRequestHmacBytes(raw);
078        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == props().size());
079        this.cargo = raw;
080        this.enabled = raw[0] == 1;
081        this.weightLbs = Bytes.readShort(raw, 1);
082        this.totalDailyInsulinUnits = raw[4];
083        this.changeBitmaskRaw = raw[5];
084        this.changeBitmask = ChangeBitmask.fromBitmask(changeBitmaskRaw);
085    }
086
087
088    public static byte[] buildCargo(boolean enabled, int weightLbs, int totalDailyInsulinUnits) {
089        return buildCargo(enabled, weightLbs, totalDailyInsulinUnits, ChangeBitmask.ENABLED.id());
090    }
091
092    public static byte[] buildCargo(boolean enabled, int weightLbs, int totalDailyInsulinUnits, int changeBitmask) {
093        return Bytes.combine(
094                new byte[]{(byte)(enabled ? 1 : 0)},
095                Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(weightLbs),
096                new byte[]{
097                        1,
098                        (byte) totalDailyInsulinUnits,
099                        (byte) changeBitmask
100                }
101        );
102    }
103

119    }
120
121    public Set<ChangeBitmask> getChangeBitmask() {
122        return changeBitmask;
123    }

125    /**
126     * Which of the settings in the request the pump should apply.
127     */
128    public enum ChangeBitmask {
129        ENABLED(1),
130        WEIGHT(2),
131        TOTAL_DAILY_INSULIN(4),
132
133        ;
134
135        private final int id;
136
137        ChangeBitmask(int id) {
138            this.id = id;
139        }
140
141        public int id() {
142            return id;
143        }
144
145        public static Set<ChangeBitmask> fromBitmask(int bitmask) {
146            Set<ChangeBitmask> set = new TreeSet<>();
147            for (ChangeBitmask i : values()) {
148                if ((bitmask & i.id()) != 0) {
149                    set.add(i);
150                }
151            }
152
153            return set;
154        }
155
156        public static int toBitmask(ChangeBitmask... items) {
157            int mask = 0;
158            for (ChangeBitmask i : items) {
159                mask |= i.id();
160            }
161
162            return mask;
163        }
164
165        public static int toBitmask(Set<ChangeBitmask> items) {
166            return toBitmask(items.toArray(new ChangeBitmask[0]));
167        }
168    }
169}
